name: cloud-keyboard
description: Cloud Keyboard — HeliBoard IME with on-device translation, voice input, and bundled sticker packs. Standalone constellation APK.

modules._doc: Keyboard libs are shared from ../ea_cloud-superapp/libs/ via relative project references in settings.gradle.

app.comment: Thin application shell. All IME components (LatinIME, SpellChecker, Settings, sticker panel, translate, voice) come from the shared keyboard libs via manifest merge.
